Pigeon Classic Charity Event was a weekend event that took place 18 - 20 October 2019, hosted by [[The Keep]] as a "CLASSIC ArenaFPS" charity event. During the weekend they hosted a cooperative game of [[DOOM Survival]] and a [[King of the Hill]] type duel tournament in [[Warfork]], which both were open for donators to participate in.

For QuakeWorld, they featured a [[QHLAN2019]] Duel Rematch between champion {{player|LocKtar|flag=se}} and runner-up  {{player|bps|flag=se}}.

The event raised funds for the [https://www.egyptiancurebank.com/ Egyptian Cure Bank] on behalf of {{player|Suplex|flag=eg}}, a young Egyptian [[Doom]] player stricken with leukemia.
